objective: Recover one-time user-authorized production OTA + Expo Hosting dispatch that failed YAML validation before starting either release workflow.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: main source 36a58a26c9b9adb9c2eff17a21b1b259c52e8da1 contains all QA-passed reader patches and a one-shot release dispatcher, but push workflow run 42372561157 failed before creating jobs due to unquoted colon in its inline condition. Existing Android/Expo production publication workflows remain unchanged; there is no verified new OTA or web release yet.
chosenApproach: Encode the exact commit-title condition as a YAML folded block scalar, preserving the one-time source gate, workflow_dispatch calls to the two original gated workflows, SHA checks, and final-publication statuses. Strengthen focused Node regression to forbid the previously invalid inline syntax.
selectionRationale: A colon followed by space inside an unquoted YAML plain scalar invalidates the workflow file. Minimal syntax-only correction preserves all release safety behavior and avoids reauthoring deployment logic.
alternativeApproaches: Modify the original production OTA workflows to deploy on every push: rejected, unsafe bypass of manual production gate.
Rerun an old successful OTA workflow SHA: rejected, it omits the new KL patches.
preserveBehaviors: Original production Android V28 runtime 1.3.2 and frozen RC verification remain required
